faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.description: Find quick answers to the most common questions about our travel packages, bookings, and services.

images.alt: Longtail boats on a turquoise beach with limestone cliffs
Traveler with a backpack and straw hat watching the sunset

items.question: How can I book a tour package?
items.answer: You can easily book a tour package through our website by selecting your destination, travel dates, and package. You can also contact our travel experts for personalized assistance.

items.question: Are your tour packages customizable?
items.answer: Yes. Every package can be tailored to your preferences, including hotels, activities, travel dates and trip duration. Just tell our team what you need and we will build it for you.

items.question: What payment options do you accept?
items.answer: We accept major credit and debit cards, UPI, net banking and bank transfers. You can also pay in easy instalments for selected packages.

items.question: Do you provide travel insurance?
items.answer: Yes, we offer optional travel insurance that covers medical emergencies, trip cancellations, delays and lost baggage. Our team will help you pick the right plan.

items.question: Can I get a refund if I cancel my trip?
items.answer: Refunds depend on the package and how close to the departure date you cancel. Our cancellation policy is shared at the time of booking, and our team will guide you through the process.
